name: Pounded bitter eggplant
summary: Raw bitter eggplant pounded with salt, chili, lá é, and scallion. It is very hot and made to go with a lot of rice.
origin: The Dak Lak provincial portal, 18 Feb 2019, says Êđê cooks also eat bitter eggplant raw, pounded.
howToEat: Take a little at a time with plenty of rice.
where: Đường sách cà phê, at a highland tasting.
seoTitle: Ca dang gia — pounded bitter eggplant
seoDescription: Raw bitter eggplant pounded with salt, chili, la e, and scallion. Very hot, eaten with plenty of rice.
taste: The Dak Lak provincial portal calls the pounded fruit very hot and deeply seasoned.
